editorialBounds: Use Base/free terminology consistently; do not imply a subscription is needed for Google Calendar or widgets.
Buying a tier does not grant calendar Owner/Writer access or override provider/workplace restrictions. Billing, provider identity and Cloud sharing identity remain separate.
Ad removal is not proof of privacy, no tracking, no server processing or no data collection. Do not add privacy assurances.
Cancellation/renewal settings are separate from unlinking a provider, deleting app/local events or revoking recipient access. Do not promise all data survives or disappears after expiry.
Current source filters verified StoreKit entitlements by expiry/revocation; do not promise paid features continue after entitlement expiry.
Check local purchase price and renewal period before purchase; no fresh Italian or other live price was queried.
Free local use does not establish all connections/sharing work without sign-in.
Apple purchase Family Sharing eligibility is not established by native code and does not itself establish calendar access.

safeItalianSemantics.base: Base include Google Calendar e Google Meet, viste del calendario, meteo e widget della schermata Home. Le connessioni e le autorizzazioni del provider restano separate.
safeItalianSemantics.advanced: Advanced include le funzioni di Base e rimuove gli annunci.
safeItalianSemantics.premium: Premium include Advanced e aggiunge il supporto per Microsoft Calendar e Microsoft Teams, nei limiti delle autorizzazioni dell’account e dell’organizzazione.
safeItalianSemantics.billing: Controlla prezzo locale, periodo di fatturazione e rinnovo prima dell’acquisto. Gestire il rinnovo dell’abbonamento è diverso da scollegare un account o eliminare dati.
